notes.title: DEV_log #4 Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hey, fellow Nomads! 

We’ve got some another updates on the development of Mr. Nomad! Our co-op mode is coming together fast, and we’re getting it ready for the upcoming demo. Right now, it’s in a very advanced state, and we’re putting it through rigorous testing to ensure a smooth and immersive experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/a83e191be7010fc75a4f781466a5291910e9ae54.gif

From synchronizing player movements to refining network stability, we’re making sure that playing together feels as seamless and engaging as possible. Our goal is to bring you a multiplayer experience that truly enhances the unique fighting and building mechanics of Mr. Nomad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/71d8c73743a2788edd00ae8d41a2a4dbdb39ad4d.gif

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/b0e3bef88c5760cdd350b006392a261f9dbb6917.png
AND BE PART OF THE PRODUCTION!

Do you even like co-op games? Got any questions? Let us know in the comments!

Truly yours,
Rejected Games

notes.title: DEV_log #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/f19c11cfe68b2a5a0da12456fa18c8d6369f5a47.png
Hello, fellow Nomads!

We're currently developing a diverse lineup of zombie types that players must face. Each one has its own unique characteristics and poses different challenges during gameplay. Below, we’ll go over the different kinds of zombies you can encounter, but for now, let’s just say you’ll need to be prepared for anything!

The Roamer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/0e9c233235fda0515b966bc179c66b14db18a56b.png
This is our most common enemy that Nomads will encounter while  playing the game, he doesn't seem that dangerous as the others  but you should still be careful because after all he's still a zombie,  right? 

The Butcher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/ba8a70f5e0e1d16a627c78e923b6c046a3ab4002.png
Oi mate, it's the Butcher, don't lose your head. He is known for  throwing a chopper at the player and is stronger than the last  zombie. Don't worry though he will spawn more rarely. 

The Exploder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/e6066ea68a1ab1a1c4f44ece9798ed5de2f9c646.png
Our bomb looking friend, well... i guess we all know what he will do,  right?
In case you don't he explodes his barrel! 

The Sprinter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/416acaebfbdbbff7734ce6d59683823f05af47ec.png
Former Olympian perhaps, a Sprinter himself, he's really fast which  makes him really hard to outrun. 

The General
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/58fa5f05702cbd720db88462ea6fb94fed58a888.png
Beware! A giant zombie joined the fight! We think of him as a boss,  he's strong, has a lot of hp and more importantly wields a giant  tank gun. 

That's it! We hope you enjoyed the enemies you'll be facing in the  game. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to tell us what  you'd like to see in the next devlog. Stay alive! 

They're coming for you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44689949/d719512fcc40bcea93200afea4a7236ece23cea5.gif

notes.title: DEV_log Introduction
notes.content:
Hello nomads!

We would like to introduce you to the DEV_log formula, which we plan to implement and publish regularly. We will try to present to you the production of Mr. Nomad from the inside - describe our ideas and analyze your opinions. The first DEV_log is informal and serves as an introduction. The next ones will be more focused on the game mechanics themselves and will contain more production materials.
